newsitem.title: USA: Omnicare Q4 diluted shr $0.17 vs $0.13.
newsitem.headline: Omnicare Q4 diluted shr $0.17 vs $0.13.

text.p: Three Months Ended Twelve Months Ended

NOTE: (a) Acquisition expenses related to a pooling of interests transaction of $690,000 pretax, or $534,000 after taxes, are included in the three and twelve month periods. Net income, excluding charge, for the three months ended Dec 31, 1996 was $13,646,000 ($0.17/primary and fully diluted share) and for the twelve months ended Dec 31, 1996 was $43,984,000 ($0.65/primary share and $0.61 fully diluted).
(b) Acquisition expenses related to a pooling of interests

transaction of $1,292,000 pretax, or $989,000 after taxes, are included in the 1995 twelve-month period. Net income, excluding this charge, for the twelve months ended December 31, 1995 was $25,749,000 ($0.49 per primary share and $0.44 fully diluted).
(c) Adjusted for two-for-one stock split distributed June 27, 1996.
(d) Reflects issuance of 10.2 million shares upon conversion of 5-3/4% Subordinated Notes.
